name: read_content
rests_on: Host-registered content backend, else bytes this process clipped. No backend and no stored body: content unavailable. Does not import a trace or memory package.

digest.description: 12 to 64 hex digest from a <ref digest="..."> or the sha256 attribute. This is the address of the full body.

session_id.description: Session the ref belongs to. Omit to use the current turn session. Passed through to the host backend.

offset.description: Character offset into the full body. Default 0. The next page starts at offset plus the length of the returned text.

limit.description: Maximum characters to return. Default 8000. A negative limit reads through the end.
